exchanges.author: c_rena
exchanges.subject: Committee: accept the Simmons demand
exchanges.body: Maribel, committee approved accepting the $30,000 limits demand. Please send written acceptance to Keel today, request a release limited to Dale Prewitt, and make sure the Baylor lien is handled. Payment authority $30,000 approved. Rena

exchanges.author: c_appraiser
exchanges.subject: LR-26-118211 (Morales) estimate
exchanges.body: Inspected Ivan Morales's 2021 F-150 today: hail damage to roof, hood, cab and bed panels; roof skin replacement plus PDR. Estimate $17,400.00, deductible $1,000. Photos and estimate in the file. Trent

exchanges.author: worker
exchanges.body: Mr. Keel, Leon River Mutual accepts your client's demand dated November 2, 2026: we will pay the $30,000.00 bodily injury limit in full settlement of Kayla Simmons's claims against our insured, Dale Prewitt, in exchange for a full release of Mr. Prewitt. We received notice of Baylor Scott & White's hospital lien ($3,210.00, filed 9/28/2026); the settlement payment will include the lienholder as a payee unless you provide a release of the lien before funding. Please send the release for review; payment will issue within 5 business days of receiving it. Maribel Ochoa

exchanges.author: c_siu
exchanges.subject: Re: SIU referral LR-26-118281
exchanges.body: Thanks Maribel, good referral. Please schedule an in-person inspection at the drive-in center and request the 2025 Brazos Valley estimate and any repair invoices from the insured. Don't discuss our concerns with him. No decision until we report. SIU

exchanges.author: worker
exchanges.subject: Authority request: LR-26-118211 (Morales) $16,400
exchanges.body: Wade, LR-26-118211 (Ivan Morales, 2021 F-150, hail): field estimate $17,400 (roof skin replacement plus PDR, photos in file); payment $16,400 after the $1,000 deductible, over my $15,000 authority. Coverage confirmed (comprehensive, in force, hail 10/29). All items now received (11/4), so the decision is due 11/30. OK to approve?

exchanges.author: worker
exchanges.subject: Claim LR-26-118281: inspection Monday 11/9 10:00
exchanges.body: Dear Mr. Ostrowski, thank you for scheduling your inspection at our drive-in center (2210 S 31st St, Temple) on Monday, November 9 at 10:00 a.m. To complete our review, please also send any estimate or repair invoices for your vehicle's hail claim with Brazos Valley Insurance in April 2025. Maribel Ochoa

exchanges.author: worker
exchanges.body: CK-7720131 ($3,880.00 to Belton Collision only) on LR-26-118240 is a duplicate of CK-7720115 (joint payee, the correct one). Please void CK-7720131 before it's cashed; if it has cleared, recover it from Belton Collision. Maribel

exchanges.author: worker
exchanges.subject: Your claim LR-26-117730: settlement accepted
exchanges.body: Dear Mr. Prewitt, good news: we have accepted Ms. Simmons's offer to settle her claim against you for your $30,000 policy limit, with a full release of you. Once the release is signed and payment made, you will have no further exposure for this claim. Please call me with any questions. Maribel Ochoa

exchanges.author: c_glen
exchanges.body: Yeah, Glen Ostrowski, claim for my Altima from the hail last week. When am I getting paid? I sent you the photos already.

exchanges.author: worker
exchanges.body: Thanks for calling, Mr. Ostrowski. I've got your photos. The next step is an in-person inspection at our drive-in center in Temple; could you bring the car in this Friday or Monday?

exchanges.author: c_glen
exchanges.body: Why do you need to see it? The photos show the dents.

exchanges.author: worker
exchanges.body: We inspect most hail claims in person to write an accurate estimate. It takes about twenty minutes. Monday at ten?
